text:
Alex H: Quick heads-up — planning SDK v18 staged rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need deploy owner, smoke owners, and rollback readiness. Canary for 10m in us-west-2 then gradually expand. Who can own the deploy and watch the canary?

Jia L: I can own the deploy (will be on standby 08:30–10:30 PT). Notes: make sure proxy shim for legacy clients is included in the chart (chart v4.2).

Samir: FYI client compatibility check: v18 keeps the same runtime API for /generate and /chat. Breaking change only for the new structured-output flag. Recommend enabling structured-output=false during canary.

Priya: I'll run the smoke tests. Smoke checklist I’ll follow:
- hit /healthz and /v1/models
- sample generate for chat and text endpoints (short prompts)
- embeddings sanity for a few vectors
- check token-level cost metrics in console
I’ll post results in this thread. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sdk-rollout :white_check_mark:

Marco: Quick QA note — saw a potential 429 pattern on embedding endpoint at ~1k QPS in last internal load test. For canary set embeddings rate-limit to 200rps per instance, or enable traffic shaping.

Jia L: A few operational bits:
- Canary kube selector: tag=canary-sdk18
- Env toggle: STRUCTURED_OUTPUT=false
- Rollback command (k8s):
```bash
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/sdk-api --to-revision=3
```
- If proxy shim missing, fallback route is /v1/compat which keeps old behavior.

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2024-08-05T16:00:00Z -> 2024-08-05T16:10:00Z. Notifying oncall and pagerduty. Auto-snapshot logs enabled.

Alex H: Thanks — owners so far: deploy = Jia L, smoke = Priya, QA monitor = Marco. Samir please coordinate client comms (note about structured-output flag). Jia, confirm the chart includes proxy shim and that rollback command is tested. If smoke passes, expand at +30m. If any errors >5% or 5xx spike, rollback immediately and post reason here.

Priya: Will post smoke results by 09:15 PT. I’ll attach quick logs and the small curl scripts I run.

Samir: I'll draft the client note (short changelog + mitigation) and share in #product-announce later today.

Marco: I’ll run a micro-load check against the canary tag before cutover and report RPS/latency. If 429s appear, I'll ask to throttle.

Jia L: Confirmed chart includes shim, and I validated the rollback command in staging. I’ll start the deploy at 09:00 PT and watch with Priya. :thumbsup:

Alex H: Great. Final: everyone please post a one-line "smoke ok" or "rollback" here. Keep comms in-thread for traceability.
